prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally art-directed high fidelity desktop website design reference for FLOWGRID, a Bangladeshi interior design studio. This is design documentation, not a coded website. Output a crisp tall canvas approximately 1536x2560, straight flat browserless webpage, no perspective laptop, no device frame. This is the FIRST THREE SECTIONS of the homepage, not an entire miniature page. A sophisticated architectural editorial site inspired in principle by immersive Mediterranean real-estate art direction: monumental refined high-contrast serif headings, composed asymmetry, architectural photography, extreme restraint. Original layout and identity, do not reproduce any existing site logo or layout exactly.
Palette: warm paper #F4F1E8, pine ink #183B35, subtle clay #895239. Body/navigation clean legible sans. Serif close to Bodoni Moda, strong enough strokes, no handwriting. Rectangular edges, hairline rules. No gradients, bento cards, shadows, badges, pill navigation, star ratings, fake counts, floating icons.
Top: solid warm paper header, 90px high, FlowGrid typographic wordmark at left, small "INTERIOR STUDIO" beneath. Right aligned clear nav Projects / Services / Studio, language control বাংলা | EN, dark pine rectangular action "Discuss your space". Header typography large and readable.
Section 1: cinematic full-width 850px-tall editorial photograph of a believable beautifully designed contemporary Dhaka family apartment living/dining room. Warm wood joinery, cream lime plaster, woven cane single chair, soft light through balcony screen, restrained olive upholstery, a few books and honest everyday details, standard urban ceiling height, no pool or mansion, no impossible furniture. Darker natural shadow in left third makes large warm-white text readable, avoid a synthetic gradient overlay. Huge narrow elegant serif heading left bottom reading exactly "Room for\neveryday life." smaller sans line "Thoughtful interiors for the way you live." One warm paper rectangular CTA "Explore our work" with small arrow. At photo bottom right small plain label "Concept interior · Design reference".
Section 2 warm paper, 350px tall with generous open space. Small uppercase left "THE FLOWGRID APPROACH". Large elegant serif heading across middle left "A considered home.\nA clearer process." On right a short readable paragraph "We begin with how you live, what your space needs, and what you want to spend." Thin pine line beneath; no icon list.
Section 3 warm paper editorial project index starting with small "SELECTED SPACES", huge serif "Spaces, with purpose." and right-aligned underlined "View projects". Two asymmetrical project photos, left 7 columns wide landscape living room, right 4 columns portrait kitchen offset down 100px with one empty column between. SAME authentic wood and warm light art direction. Captions "Apartment study 01" and "Kitchen study 02"; small second line "Illustrative concept". No fake real project places, budget or credentials. Enough whitespace, refined proportion, credible premium website. Tiny outside-board caption bottom "FLOWGRID / DESKTOP HOME / CONCEPT 01". All text crisp and deliberate. Do not add more sections.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a second coordinated high-fidelity website reference for FlowGrid Bangladeshi interior studio: a complete EDITORIAL PROJECT DETAIL page overview, tall approximately 1536x2560 flat canvas with no browser or device frame. Match the recently generated FlowGrid reference in this conversation: warm paper #F4F1E8, dark pine #183B35, Bodoni-like refined serif headings and clean sans-serif reading text, thin rules, squared corners, generous margins, realistic urban Dhaka apartment photography with warm wood, cane, plaster, greenery and natural light. The page must feel commissioned by a real architectural studio, no generic template bento, no floating decorative elements, no gradients or shadows.
Header identical visual family: FlowGrid wordmark left, Projects / Services / Studio, বাংলা | EN, pine rectangle "Discuss your space".
Top project title on paper "Apartment study 01" in large serif, small text "Illustrative concept · Not a completed FlowGrid project", breadcrumb "Projects / Apartment study 01". Thin horizontal metadata strip with three labels "TYPE: FAMILY APARTMENT" "FOCUS: LIVING + STORAGE" "STATUS: DESIGN CONCEPT". No fabricated sizes, prices, project counts, real clients or testimonials.
Wide hero 16:9 concept photography: believable family living room with window light, wood floor-to-ceiling built-in storage, cream sofa, a cane chair and books, urban balcony in Bangladesh, standard ceiling heights.
Next paper editorial two-column text, small index "01 / THE BRIEF", large serif "More space for\neveryday living." and readable short paragraph "A concept study exploring flexible seating, practical storage and a calmer shared space." Then two large photographs of same room consistent geometry: wood joinery detail on left 4:5, broader dining view right landscape.
Below a restrained three-row ruled section heading "Design decisions". Rows "01  Make storage part of the room" / "02  Keep movement clear" / "03  Bring daylight further inside". Plenty of whitespace, no cards.
Bottom wide deep pine inquiry strip warm white big serif "What does your space need?" and crisp white outlined rectangular button "Discuss your space". Small footer "FlowGrid     Projects     Services     Rumi's portfolio".
Small document label at bottom "FLOWGRID / PROJECT DETAIL / CONCEPT 02". Images and exact text are examples for design review only. Maintain strong typographic hierarchy, legible text, careful alignment and natural photographic material texture.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity design presentation board of TWO DISTINCT DESKTOP PAGES side by side for FlowGrid Bangladeshi interior studio, in the EXACT coordinated art direction of the preceding references: warm off-white #F4F1E8 paper, very dark pine #183B35 ink, elegant Bodoni-like serif display and legible clean sans-serif labels, squared controls, hairline rules, generous margins, honest warm wood urban interior photos. Flat screenshots, no device frames or perspective. Wide board approximately 2560x2048. A narrow muted light gray gutter separates the pages. Tiny external board headings "03 / SERVICES" and "04 / ENQUIRY". These pages are visual concepts; do not invent credentials, prices, contact numbers or promises.
LEFT PAGE:
Simple solid paper header FLOWGRID left and compact nav Projects / Services / Studio, small "Discuss your space" pine action right.
Generous title block serif "Design around\nyour everyday." supporting one sentence "A starting point for planning a more useful, comfortable home." Small plain label "Proposed service structure".
Strong horizontal photograph of practical warm Bangladeshi apartment kitchen with timber cabinets and tiled worktop, light through window and small ordinary cooking objects, clearly aspirational design concept.
Three generous ruled service rows below, NOT CARDS:
"01  Home interiors" with short text "Layout, material direction and room-by-room planning."
"02  Kitchens & storage" with short text "Make daily routines easier through thoughtful planning."
"03  Renovation planning" with short text "Understand the scope before work begins."
Arrow at far right each. A small material detail strip with cane and wood photograph beside a serif heading "From the first conversation\nto a clear plan." Five small simple numbered process words on paper "Brief / Visit / Design / Agree / Deliver" displayed as quiet typographic progression, no bubbly icons.
Deep pine closing panel with white serif "Tell us about your space." and paper rectangular "Start an enquiry".
RIGHT PAGE:
Same header.
Title serif "Let's begin\nwith your space." plain sans supporting line "Share a few details with the FlowGrid team."
Spacious SINGLE-COLUMN ENQUIRY FORM with permanent visible labels, 52px-tall squared outlined fields, generous 24px gaps. Labels "Your name *" empty field, "Mobile number *" field placeholder "01XXXXXXXXX", "Area or city *" field placeholder "e.g. Mirpur, Dhaka". Native-looking selector label "What do you need? *" placeholder "Choose a service" dropdown arrow. Additional unfilled optional labels "Approximate area (optional)" with placeholder "Square feet", "Budget (optional)" with placeholder "Not decided yet". "Tell us more (optional)" multi-line box. No form divided into tiny columns.
Small plain text "We will use these details to respond to your enquiry." underlined "Privacy notice". Large pine full-width button "Send enquiry". Beneath quiet alternative "Prefer a conversation?  WhatsApp  /  Call".
A pale mist #DEE7E2 editorial block below heading "What happens next?" and short text "The team reviews your request and contacts you to discuss the scope." No automatic booking or fake 24-hour promise. Small footer FlowGrid, Rumi's portfolio, Privacy.
At board bottom outside page tiny caption "FLOWGRID / SERVICE + ENQUIRY / CONCEPT REFERENCES". Ensure text is large enough, sharp, coherent, alignment impeccable; no gradients, glowing blobs, glass panels, shadows, fake reviews, floating chat bubbles, rounded cards.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished responsive MOBILE UI design reference board for FlowGrid Bangladesh interior studio matching the last three FlowGrid desktop references: paper #F4F1E8, pine ink #183B35, restrained warm natural interior imagery, squared controls, crisp thin rules, no shadows, no gradients, no giant rounded cards. Board approximately 2048x1536 landscape, THREE tall flat mobile viewport rectangles aligned with subtle gray gutters and small external English labels "01 HOME / বাংলা", "02 PROJECTS / বাংলা", "03 ENQUIRY / বাংলা". No phones, no perspective or hands. These are clear 390px-wide mobile designs rendered large on the board, generous readable Bengali sans-serif like Noto Sans Bengali with correct conjuncts, 18px body text equivalent, 44-48px touch controls. Do not shrink desktop layout.
ALL screens have solid paper header: FLOWGRID typographic serif wordmark left, "EN" and clear "মেনু" right. Wordmark is provisional. Space for navigation. Keep readable and restrained.

HOME screen:
Below header on solid paper, small "ইন্টেরিয়র ডিজাইন", large beautiful Bengali headline exact "আপনার জীবনের ছন্দে,\nআপনার ঘর।" with proper Bengali letter shaping and roomy line height. Normal text "আপনার প্রয়োজন, পছন্দ ও বাজেট বুঝে ঘরের পরিকল্পনা।" Dark pine rectangular prominent button "আমাদের কাজ দেখুন".
Below, one edge-to-edge large portrait concept photograph of contemporary Dhaka apartment: warm wood joinery, cream seating, cane chair, urban balcony light, believable modest scale, no villa. Plain caption "কনসেপ্ট ডিজাইন" below photo. Bottom next section start small "FLOWGRID" and clear Bengali heading "ভাবনা থেকে পরিকল্পনা". No sticky action bar covering content in this initial viewport.

PROJECTS screen:
Paper heading "আমাদের কাজ" and small subline "জায়গা ও প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী পরিকল্পনা". One large landscape warm apartment photo, text "অ্যাপার্টমেন্ট স্টাডি ০১", visible small status "কনসেপ্ট ডিজাইন". A plain underlined "বিস্তারিত দেখুন" link. Next image kitchen wood and tiled worktop, caption "কিচেন স্টাডি ০২", visible "কনসেপ্ট ডিজাইন". At bottom a solid paper persistent contact bar with two generously sized outlined/filled rectangular actions "কল করুন" and "কথা বলুন". It has reserved space and does not overlap images or text. No floating green bubble.

ENQUIRY screen:
Large Bengali heading "আপনার ঘর নিয়ে\nকথা বলি।"
Small body "কিছু তথ্য দিন। FlowGrid টিম আপনার সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ করবে।"
A single column usable form with visible labels and tall empty bordered inputs:
"আপনার নাম *"
"মোবাইল নম্বর *" placeholder "01XXXXXXXXX"
"এলাকা বা শহর *" placeholder "যেমন: মিরপুর, ঢাকা"
"কী ধরনের কাজ প্রয়োজন? *" dropdown placeholder "বেছে নিন"
Below simple disclosure row "আরও তথ্য (ঐচ্ছিক)" with plus sign.
Small privacy sentence "আপনার সঙ্গে যোগাযোগের জন্যই এই তথ্য ব্যবহার করা হবে।"
Full width dark pine button "অনুরোধ পাঠান".
Below "WhatsApp-এ কথা বলুন" underlined. Bottom quiet "গোপনীয়তা নীতি". No sticky contact bar on this form page. No fictional phone, price, star rating, project count or claims.
Outside the board at bottom tiny note "FLOWGRID / MOBILE CONCEPTS / GENERATED INTERIORS". The Bengali UI is the primary language, keep exact text clean and large, editorial art direction and excellent legibility.
